$comment: Copy the keys you need into .devbook/config.json. Every key is optional; an absent key takes the engine's documented default. Roles and services start unbound: fill each with a provider id — `plugin:skill`, a bare `plugin` resolved through its role, or `repo:<skill>` — naming whichever specialist plugin you installed. A service that takes options is an object instead, e.g. { "provider": "…", "host": "aspire" }. delivery.mcp binds MCP servers per extension point by the id your own MCP configuration declares; a point left out takes the engine default, and mcp-template.json / mcp-vscode-template.json beside this file declare those default servers for .mcp.json and .vscode/mcp.json. Validate with tools/stack-config/check.mjs. The contract is resources/surface-contract.md. Never put a model or a secret in this file.

gates.prompt: Only one runtime instance runs here. OK to start?
